From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Discovery recap & proposed contract routing for Helios Health

Hi Laura — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have a single plan to share with your team: 

Summary of call:
- Use case: Helios wants to embed Redwood Inference for clinical note summarization and triage assistance across 3 pilot clinics (mid-Jan pilot target).
- Decision criteria: accuracy on clinical prompts, latency under 400ms p50, data residency/controls, and clear per-token economics for pilot scale (~100k tokens/month).
- Economic buyer: Evan Park (VP Clinical Ops) — Laura confirmed Evan owns the budget for pilot.
- Security/procurement: Laura flagged Sophie Marquez (legal) and Tim O'Neill (procurement) as primary reviewers.

Recommended contract routing and sequencing:
1) NDA (mutual) — quick sign to enable deeper technical exchange (redline attached for quick review). Target turn time: 3 business days.
2) Proof-of-concept + SOW language (scope & SLAs) — align during pilot.
3) MSA/DPA redline sprint — propose a 2-week legal review window after NDA, with procurement checklist run in parallel.

Attached: Helios_NDA_v1_redline.pdf (draft redline from our legal that preserves confidentiality and limits data usage; this is a draft we can fast-track).

Asks / next steps (proposed):
- Laura: confirm owners and expected review SLAs for NDA and MSA (you mentioned 2–3 weeks for MSA; pls confirm).
- Tim/Sophie: can you confirm whether Helios requires a separate DPA or if it will be appended to the MSA?
- Evan (cc if helpful): confirm target approval window for pilot budget (we're aiming to enable infra by 01/10).

I'll loop in Marissa (sales ops) to propose routing and DocuSign cadence once we confirm owners. Happy to hop on a 15-min sync with legal/procurement this week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Looping in sales ops/legal notes and proposed execution plan. Quick thoughts on routing and owners from Redwood ops/legal perspective so we can set expectations with Helios: 

Proposed routing (Redwood recommendation):
- Phase A (fast lane): Sign mutual NDA first. Use DocuSign single-signature per party. Target: 3 business days.
- Phase B (pilot): Run SOW + technical onboarding in parallel to NDA where possible (scope doc to be owned by Ben; infra onboarding by Rishi).
- Phase C (contract): After pilot scope is locked, run MSA redline sprint. Our legal can commit to turn-around drafts in ~5 business days per round; typical 2 rounds = 2 weeks.

DPA approach: we usually append the DPA as an exhibit to the MSA for enterprise accounts like Helios. If Sophie requires a standalone DPA, we can provide that but it may add time. Sophie — can you confirm preference?

DocuSign cadence & owners:
- NDA: Ben to send initial DocuSign (Marissa to prepare template).
- MSA redline: Ben to share proposed MSA (attached Redwood_MSA_proposal_v2.docx). Legal (Rishi) will run redline and coordinate with Sophie. Procurement (Tim) to supply required PO language from intake form.

Estimated end-to-end (pilot contract closure): ~3–5 weeks depending on MSA negotiation depth. If Helios is comfortable with Redwood's standard confidentiality and DPA language, it can be toward the shorter end. 

Action items: 
- Ben: confirm timeline to send NDA via DocuSign (ETA: EOD today?).
- Rishi: stand by to take the first redline pass once Sophie returns comments.
- Tim/Sophie: if you can provide any required terms (specific indemnity clauses, export controls, or data residency needs), send them into this thread.

Thanks — I attached our current MSA draft for reference.

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks all — summarizing agreed plan and owners so we have a single record. I’ve included the procurement intake spreadsheet from Laura and attached a copy here as well. 

Agreed routing & owners:
- NDA (mutual): Ben to send via DocuSign today (Helios target: 3 business days). Owner: Ben (send), Sophie & Tim (review).
- Pilot SOW / onboarding: Ben to draft initial SOW; Rishi to coordinate infra/technical onboarding. Target: pilot infra live by 2027-01-10.
- MSA + DPA redline sprint: Sophie (legal) + Rishi (Redwood legal) to exchange redlines; target 10 business days for first pass, 5 business days for iteration. Procurement (Tim) to parallel-process PO items.

Action items (owners & target dates):

- Sophie: initial NDA review (target 2026-12-21).
- Tim: confirm PO terms and any vendor onboarding blockers (target 2026-12-22).
- Rishi: stand by to take MSA redline once we have Sophie’s initial comments (start 2026-12-22).
- Marissa: prepare DocuSign template and track sign-off milestones in HubSpot.

Notes / exceptions:
